_meta.spec: CC Decision Engine tox.json - built on the OVCA_Decision_Engine_Spec_v0.1 §6 task 1 conventions (data/tox.json of the OVCA repo), format and field conventions copied from the EMCA engine's data/tox.json
_meta.hard_rule_3: Unreported fields are the literal string "not_reported". No estimation, no inference, no carry-over from model knowledge of the trial. Every number is copied from the structured extract; no PDF was needed (every extract used has a toxicity section).

field_conventions.grade3plus_any_pct: ANY-CAUSE grade >=3 rate. Where a source reports only TREATMENT-RELATED grade >=3 (Dueñas-González, GOG-9929, the single-arm IO and ADC phase II trials, CheckMate 358), the any-cause field is "not_reported" and the figure is carried in treatment_related_grade3plus_pct. Where G3, G4 (and G5) are worst-grade-per-patient categories their sum is exact and is stored with "derived_sum": true (RTOG 90-01 acute). Per-category grade counts (GOG-109, GOG-120, GOG-85, GOG-179, GOG-240, GOG-169, Bonomi, GOG-204, JCOG0505, the old GOG phase IIs, Chang, JCOG 0102, Gupta) are NOT summed. Event-count tables (TACO) and category totals not stated to be per patient (NCIC CTG) are not_reported. A printed per-patient 'grade 3-4' rate is carried as G>=3 where the source states no treatment-related deaths (GOG-263, STARS, GOG-123, INTERLACE) and, with the deaths named in notes, where deaths are listed separately (GOG-92, CALLA, EORTC 55994); KEYNOTE-826 and EMPOWER-Cervical 1 print grade 3-5. RT-related grade >=3 (acute/late GI-GU) is carried in notes as the extract gives it.
field_conventions.treatment_related_grade3plus_pct: Grade >=3 AEs attributed to treatment (TRAE / 'related to study drug'), a lower bound for any-cause. Immune-related-only G>=3 rates are not used here (notes only).
field_conventions.dose_reduction_pct: A true dose-reduction rate. 'Dose interruption' (balstilimab trials) is "not_reported" with the figure in notes. Only innovaTV 204, DESTINY-PanTumor02 and irinotecan print one.
field_conventions.discontinuation_pct: Discontinuation due to adverse events / toxicity. Where the source mixes toxicity and other reasons (NOGGO-AGO early termination), prints counts without a denominator (STARS, GOG-85, GOG-227C, JCOG 0102) or uses a non-safety denominator, the value is a string saying so. TRAE-only discontinuation (KEYNOTE-A18, CALLA, CheckMate 358, IO phase IIs) is labelled in notes. Discontinuation of 'any component / any agent' (KEYNOTE-A18, KEYNOTE-826, COMPASSION-16, BEATcc) is labelled in notes.
field_conventions.arms: Randomised trials carry every arm under 'arms', keyed by a short arm label (GOG-240 four arms of the 2x2, GOG-204 four, GOG-120 / STARS / Bonomi / GOG-179 three); top-level fields describe the experimental arm (a string listing each arm where there are several). CheckMate 358 (three cohorts, two randomised) also carries them under 'arms'. Arm 'n' is the safety denominator given by the extract.
field_conventions.evidence_quote: Verbatim text from the source extract; several fragments are joined by ' || ', each fragment verbatim (checked programmatically against the file by the build script). Figures from additional_sources are quoted in notes only.
field_conventions.label: '<name as in the note> (<first author> <year>)'; other files match on the part before ' ('. One entry per trial, however many notes/tables list it; extra extracts of the same trial are in additional_sources. Where the two notes name a trial differently (GOG-109 'RTOG intergroup' vs 'RTOG 91-12'; 'Gemcitabine, GOG (non-SCC)' vs 'Gemcitabine, GOG non-squamous'; 'GOG 76-U' vs 'GOG 76-U topotecan'; 'GOG-227C' vs 'GOG-227C bevacizumab') the squamous note's label is used, except Schilder 2005 which takes the adenocarcinoma note's label (its main row). Prefix collisions for tox_ref: use 'Balstilimab (' (not 'Balstilimab', which also matches 'Balstilimab + zalifrelimab'), 'Gemcitabine, GOG (SCC)' vs 'Gemcitabine, GOG non-squamous', 'GOG-240 (' is unique.

_meta.coverage: All randomised and single-arm prospective trial rows with a structured extract (📝) in the two CXCA v1.1 algorithm notes (squamous cell, adenocarcinoma), all settings. Each trial placed once, in the table of its main setting (INTERLACE sits in Table 2A although both notes also list it in Table 4; KEYNOTE-826 and the other 3A trials once although both notes carry them). Rows the adenocarcinoma note marks ❌ excluded (SCC-only trials) are still included because the trial itself is relevant to the squamous pool.
